battle.name: 波斯立憲革命
battle.brief: 波斯立憲革命於1905年在德黑蘭興起，改革派要求召開民選議會、制定憲法並限制國王專權，穆罕默德沙阿一度拒絕並召回改革派支持者，促成全國性反對浪潮。英國海軍於1865年已列裝蒸汽鐵甲艦（Steam ironclad），顯示當時海上兵力現代化背景。

kit.name: 蒸汽鐵甲艦
kit.history: 蒸汽鐵甲艦以蒸汽機推進並配備鐵甲防護，屬英國海軍的海上主力艦艇類別，承接風帆戰艦並為後來蒸汽主力艦奠定基礎。

countries: 題名中的1905年是波斯立憲革命爆發與第一次國會成立的年份，完整的軍事弧線則延續至1911至1912年的第二次國會圍攻。交戰雙方沒有正式對外宣戰：王室陣線以卡扎爾王朝中央政府、德黑蘭駐軍、哥薩克旅、相關步兵部隊與.fields砲隊為核心；反對陣線以Hji Mohammad Kazim、Shaykh Muhammad Ali Babi所代表的宗教政治勢力，以及後來成立的第一屆國會與支持軍官為核心，沒有可與德黑蘭駐軍相當的常備野戰兵。主要戰場集中於德黑蘭中央的司法宮一帶、阿卜杜勒－阿齊姆聖陵及通往德黑蘭東南約十二公里的道路；1908年的戰事又延伸至卡爾季河、伊斯法罕與法爾斯通往德黑蘭的北部進軍路線，1909年衝突擴及大不里士。英國與俄國並非交戰國：俄方在1907至1908年以外交與軍援支援王室一方，英國則在1909年登陸並以軍事威脅促成國會復會，但都沒有直接參加攻擊司法宮的巷戰。
countriesEn: The year 1905 in the title marks the outbreak of the Persian Constitutional Revolution and the establishment of its first parliament, while the complete military arc continued through the second siege of the parliament in 1911 and 1912. Neither side had declared war on a foreign state. The royalist side centered on the Qajar central government, the Tehran garrison, the Cossack Brigade, associated infantry units, and artillery. The opposing side centered on the religious-political movement associated with Hji Mohammad Kazim and Shaykh Muhammad Ali Babi, followed by the first Majlis and the military officers who supported it, and it possessed no permanent field army comparable to the Tehran garrison. The principal theater centered on the Edifice of Justice in central Tehran, the Shah Abdol-Azim shrine, and the road roughly twelve kilometers southeast of the capital. The fighting of 1908 extended to the Karaj River and the northern approaches from Isfahan and Fars into Tehran, while the conflict of 1909 spread to Tabriz. Britain and Russia were not belligerents. Russia supported the royal government diplomatically and with military supplies in 1907 and 1908, while Britain landed troops and applied military pressure in 1909, leading to the restoration of the Majlis, but neither directly participated in the street fighting around the Edifice of Justice.
people: Hji Mohammad Kazim是最早把宗教領袖身份轉化為全國政治行動的關鍵人物。他在1901年即以阿卜杜勒－阿齊姆聖陵為據點發動絕食抗爭，要求整頓司法、罷免失職省長並限制任性行政；1905年7月再續絕食，使要求不再限於地方爭議。Shaykh Muhammad Ali Babi是巴比運動的重要武裝與組織核心，1905年7月30日政府同時下令逮捕他與Kazim，7月31日雙方槍戰時Babi身亡；Kazim其後一度被押入德黑蘭並不久獲釋。卡扎爾國王Mozaffar al-Din Shah最初選擇逮捕與武力壓制，至8月5日才同意召集代表會議；首相兼內政大臣Mirza Ali Asghar Khan Amin al-Sultan則是7月拘捕行動的策動者，也是轉向以國會吸納反對派的政府代表。第一屆國會成立後，Najafi Khan、Sattar Khan與Reza Khan構成1908年反國會軍事行動的核心；Sheikh Khazal Khan曾奉國會之命斡旋，卻在1908年6月遭王室派軍隊擊殺。Mohammad Ali Khan Arfa al-Saltaneh於1909年在大不里士組織反攻，迫使中央政府重開國會。1910年Mozaffar al-Din Shah去世後，Mohammad Shah繼位；1911年12月29日首相Amir Bahadur Nasir al-Din在阿卜杜勒－阿齊姆聖陵遇刺身亡，國會隨即遭包圍，1912年1月再受砲擊。
peopleEn: Hji Mohammad Kazim was the central figure who transformed the authority of a religious leader into a nationwide political movement. In 1901 he had already begun a hunger strike at the Shah Abdol-Azim shrine, demanding judicial reform, the dismissal of negligent provincial governors, and limits on arbitrary administration. He resumed the fast in July 1905, turning a local grievance into a national political confrontation. Shaykh Muhammad Ali Babi was the principal armed and organizational leader of the Babi movement. On 30 July 1905 the government ordered the arrest of both Babi and Kazim, and Babi was killed during the fighting of 31 July. Kazim was taken to Tehran for a time and was released shortly afterward. Qajar Shah Mozaffar al-Din initially chose arrest and armed suppression, but on 5 August he conceded the need for a representative assembly. His grand vizier and interior minister, Mirza Ali Asghar Khan Amin al-Sultan, had directed the July arrest operation and subsequently represented the government in the turn toward absorbing opposition through a parliament. After the first Majlis was established, Najafi Khan, Sattar Khan, and Reza Khan became the core of the anti-parliamentary military movement in 1908. Sheikh Khazal Khan was sent by the Majlis to mediate but was killed by royalist troops in June 1908. Mohammad Ali Khan Arfa al-Saltaneh organized resistance in Tabriz in 1909 and compelled the central government to restore the parliament. Mozaffar al-Din Shah died in 1910 and was succeeded by Mohammad Shah. On 29 December 1911 Prime Minister Amir Bahadur Nasir al-Din was assassinated at the Shah Abdol-Azim shrine. The Majlis was then surrounded and subjected to artillery fire in January 1912.
kits: 波斯軍在1905至1912年間沒有完全統一的制式裝備，但主要型號均有實物使用記錄。哥薩克旅最可靠的骨幹裝備是英國Martini－Henry步槍，代表改型包括1871年的Mark I與1889年的Mark IV，使用.577／450邊火藥匣；部分中央步兵另外使用8公厘Mannlicher－M1888／90步槍，軍械庫中亦保留較早的奧製Werndl M1879。哥薩克旅及中央軍的精銳單位配備水冷式Maxim重機槍，使用.303英制機槍彈帶。砲兵方面是英製Armstrong後膛野砲與更早的舊式銅製前膛砲混編，而非單一制式口徑；因此1908與1912年的圍攻可以確定由野戰砲執行，卻不能可靠地為每門砲指定口徑、型號或射擊彈數。步兵彈藥由.577／450、8公厘等不同庫存分發，Maxim使用.303連發機槍彈，砲彈則依口徑由德黑蘭中央兵站分送前膛藥包或後膛砲彈。馬匹、馬車、驃馬馱運和砲車是主要機動與後勤手段；遠距離命令在電報線遭切斷後依靠騎兵與步行信使，糧秣、飲水、馬匹飼料和散熱水源則決定砲隊在城外與中央街區能停留多久。這些型號的射擊精度、後膛可靠性與訓練差異，也造成1905年交火的火力不整齊，以及1908年後外援方能迅速轉移砲位的限制。
kitsEn: The Persian armed forces did not possess a completely standardized inventory between 1905 and 1912, but their principal types all had real service records. The best-established equipment of the Cossack Brigade was the British Martini-Henry rifle, represented by the 1871 Mark I and the 1889 Mark IV, firing .577/450 rimfire cartridges. Parts of the central infantry also carried the 8mm Mannlicher-M1888/90 rifle, while older Austrian Werndl M1879 rifles remained in the arsenals. Elite units of the Cossack Brigade and central army were equipped with the water-cooled Maxim machine gun and .303-inch ammunition. Artillery was a mixture of British Armstrong breech-loading field guns and much older bronze muzzle-loading pieces rather than a single standardized caliber. It is therefore certain that field artillery carried out the sieges of 1908 and 1912, but the surviving evidence cannot reliably assign a caliber, exact model, or shell count to each gun. Infantry ammunition was issued from separate stocks for .577/450, 8mm rifles, and other weapons, while Maxim guns used linked .303 ammunition. Field-gun ammunition was distributed from the central arsenal in Tehran according to caliber, including black-powder charges for older pieces and complete rounds for breech-loading guns. Horses, horse-drawn wagons, mule packs, artillery limbers, and caissons provided the main means of movement and logistics. Once telegraph lines were cut, long-distance orders depended on mounted and foot messengers. Fodder, water, draught animals, and access to cooling water for Maxim guns determined how long artillery and machine-gun units could remain outside the city or within its crowded districts. Differences in accuracy, breech reliability, ammunition supply, and training produced the uneven fire of the July 1905 clashes and limited the speed with which opposing artillery could be repositioned after 1908.
tactics: 整場衝突可分成1905年的拘捕與街區對抗、1908年的反國會圍攻，以及1911至1912年的第二次圍攻。1905年7月，王室政府先企圖以逮捕切斷宗教反對派的核心，而不是立即發動會戰；混合分遣隊由德黑蘭向東南聖陵推進，成員包括正規步兵、哥薩克騎兵與宮廷警衛，步兵負責封鎖狹窄道路和建築入口，騎兵控制兩側、傳遞命令並追擊散開者，但可靠史料沒有留下各營確切位置。7月31日槍戰後，政府沒有取得決定性摧毀，遂在8月轉採政治吸納：設於司法宮的第一屆國會由指定警衛保護，出入口與周邊道路受到管制，王室保留軍隊與核心行政權，使國會既成為制度成果，也處在軍力包圍之下。1908年，Najafi Khan、Sattar Khan與Reza Khan所部集中步兵、哥薩克部隊和可沿道路機動的野戰砲，由法爾斯及伊斯法罕方向向德黑蘭推進，切斷國會與外省的聯絡，並在司法宮周邊部署火砲；6月擊殺Sheikh Khazal Khan切斷斡旋後，王室派於7月包圍中央街區，以砲火破壞建築及防守陣位，再由步兵進入肅清。1911年12月事件後，Mohammad Shah再次調集首都駐軍與砲隊，封鎖通往司法宮的接近道路，把火砲置於鄰近營地、廣場及能形成直射線的街區，於1912年1月連續射擊。國會一方沒有能與之抗衡的野戰縱隊，防守主要依靠司法宮結構、警衛與有限武器，因此兩次圍攻在戰術上都由王室軍隊得手；但每次武力解散都留下軍令正當性與中央控制受損的問題。
tacticsEn: The conflict can be divided into the arrests and urban fighting of 1905, the anti-parliamentary siege of 1908, and the second siege of 1911 and 1912. In July 1905 the royal government first attempted to decapitate the religious opposition through arrest rather than immediately launching a pitched battle. A mixed detachment moved southeast from Tehran toward the shrine, combining regular infantry, Cossack riders, and palace guards. Infantry blocked narrow approaches and entrances, while cavalry controlled the flanks, carried messages, and pursued dispersed groups, although no reliable record identifies the exact position of each company. After the shooting of 31 July failed to produce a decisive destruction of the opposition, the government shifted in August toward political absorption. The first Majlis, housed in the Edifice of Justice, was protected by designated guards, while access points and surrounding roads were controlled. The monarchy retained the army and the core administrative power, leaving the parliament both an institutional achievement and an assembly enclosed by military force. In 1908, the forces associated with Najafi Khan, Sattar Khan, and Reza Khan concentrated infantry, Cossack troops, and mobile field artillery, advanced toward Tehran through the Fars and Isfahan approaches, severed the Majlis from the provinces, and emplaced guns around the Edifice of Justice. The killing of Sheikh Khazal Khan in June removed the channel for mediation. In July, royalist troops isolated the central district, used artillery fire to break the building and its defensive positions, and then entered with infantry. Following the December 1911 assassination, Mohammad Shah once more concentrated the capital garrison and artillery, closed the approaches to the Edifice of Justice, and positioned guns in nearby barracks, open squares, and streets offering direct firing lines for the bombardment of January 1912. The parliamentary side had no field army capable of matching them. Its resistance depended chiefly on the structure of the Edifice of Justice, guards, and a limited supply of weapons, so the royalists won both sieges tactically. Every forcible dissolution nevertheless damaged the legitimacy of military command and the stability of central control.
data: 可核對的時間表顯示：1905年7月下旬Hji Mohammad Kazim恢復絕食，罷市與切斷德黑蘭對外電報線通常被置於7月29日前後；7月30日政府下達拘捕令，7月31日聖陵一帶發生槍戰，Shaykh Muhammad Ali Babi身亡；8月5日國王宣布召集代表會議，8月7日第一屆Majlis在司法宮開議。第一屆國會通常記載為156席，但它不是普選議會，宗教人士、商界代表、土地所有者、王族及地方精英占有主要席位。1906年8月完成憲法文本，12月30日由Mozaffar al-Din Shah頒布正式敕令。1908年6月Najafi Khan一派與國會支持的Sheikh Khazal Khan在卡爾季河一帶談判破裂，後者被殺；7月底司法宮遭砲擊與突擊，Kazim受傷，其後被押往設拉子並於1909年去世。1909年4月英軍登陸造成外交與軍事壓力，年底Majlis重新召集；1910年7月Mozaffar al-Din Shah去世，Mohammad Shah即位；1911年12月29日Amir Bahadur Nasir al-Din遇刺，1912年1月9日前後司法宮遭砲擊後投降。波斯全國常備軍及哥薩克旅的1905年精確可戰人數沒有可信點名表，參戰分遣隊更無完整名冊；三個階段的傷亡數字亦因屍體未收埋、屍體處理方式不同及事後宣傳誇大而不一致，因此本文不列任何精確傷亡總數。
dataEn: The verifiable chronology places the resumption of Hji Mohammad Kazim's hunger strike in late July 1905. The closure of the market and the cutting of telegraph lines between Tehran and the provinces are usually dated to around 29 July. The government issued its arrest orders on 30 July, fighting occurred around the shrine on 31 July, and Shaykh Muhammad Ali Babi was killed. On 5 August the Shah announced a representative assembly, and on 7 August the first Majlis opened in the Edifice of Justice. The first parliament is usually recorded as having 156 seats, although it was not a body elected by universal suffrage. Clerics, commercial representatives, landowners, royal princes, and local elites occupied most of those positions. The constitutional text was completed in August 1906, and Mozaffar al-Din Shah issued the formal decree on 30 December. In June 1908 negotiations between the forces of Najafi Khan and Sheikh Khazal Khan, supported by the Majlis, broke down near the Karaj River, and Sheikh Khazal was killed. At the end of July the Edifice of Justice was bombarded and assaulted; Kazim was wounded, taken to Shiraz, and died there in 1909. A British landing in April 1909 created diplomatic and military pressure, and the Majlis reassembled at the end of that year. Mozaffar al-Din Shah died in July 1910 and was succeeded by Mohammad Shah. Amir Bahadur Nasir al-Din was assassinated on 29 December 1911, and the Edifice of Justice capitulated around 9 January 1912 after artillery fire. No trustworthy muster establishes the exact number of troops available from the Qajar army and Cossack Brigade in 1905, and no complete roster survives for the detachments actually engaged. Casualty totals for all three phases are also inconsistent because of incomplete burial, differing methods of counting the dead, and exaggerated postwar claims, so no precise casualty figure is given here.
cause: 立憲革命的根源並非單一宮廷衝突，而是卡扎爾王朝的財政、行政與軍事壓力同時累積。Nasir al-Din Shah在1896年遇刺後，中央缺乏穩固的繼承與行政控制，Mozaffar al-Din Shah雖曾試圖改革，權力仍集中於宮廷、總督與傳統官僚。對外借款、關稅安排與讓予外國利益加重財政壓力；地方治理、軍紀和司法標準不一致，則使宗教領袖能以整頓司法和罷免省長為具體訴求。Kazim自1901年起反覆使用絕食，說明反對派早已要求把行政爭議提升為全國性代表制度。Amin al-Sultan本人並非全然反動，他支持有限改革，但傾向由王室主持、由上而下推行；反對派則要求國會成為持續運作的監督與立法機關。1905年7月，市場停閉與電報中斷把罷食、拘捕爭議和地方動員連成危機；7月30日逮捕Kazim與Babi的命令則把政治抗爭直接轉成軍警行動，使王室企圖以奪取領導人的方式終止危機。這一失敗削弱了純粹鎮壓策略，促成8月的國會讓步。1906年憲法確立後，宮廷與國會就軍隊指揮、官僚職權及君主權限的衝突加深；1907年起的王室反制、俄方支持以及1908年軍事圍攻，遂成為同一革命後半段的新戰爭原因。
causeEn: The Constitutional Revolution did not arise from a single palace dispute. Fiscal, administrative, and military pressures within the Qajar state accumulated together. Following the assassination of Nasir al-Din Shah in 1896, succession and central administration remained unstable. Mozaffar al-Din Shah attempted reform, but effective power remained concentrated in the court, provincial governors, and traditional officials. Foreign borrowing, customs arrangements, and the concession of foreign interests intensified fiscal strain, while inconsistent provincial government, military discipline, and judicial standards gave religious leaders concrete demands concerning judicial reform and the removal of provincial governors. Kazim's repeated use of hunger strikes from 1901 onward showed that the opposition had already sought to elevate administrative grievances into a national demand for representative institutions. Amin al-Sultan was not simply reactionary; he supported limited reform, but favored controlled reform conducted from above by the monarchy. The opposition instead sought a continuously functioning parliament with genuine supervisory and legislative authority. In July 1905, the market closure and interruption of telegraph communications linked the fast, the arrest dispute, and provincial mobilization into a national crisis. The order of 30 July to arrest Kazim and Babi converted a political confrontation into an operation by the military and police, because the monarchy believed that removing the leadership would end the disturbance. The failure of that method weakened the strategy of pure repression and produced the parliamentary concession of August. After the constitution was established in 1906, disputes over command of the armed forces, bureaucratic authority, and the scope of royal power deepened. The royal counteroffensive beginning in 1907, Russian support, and the military siege of 1908 became the causes of the second phase of the same revolution.
impact: 1905年的軍事與政治結果，是國會第一次取得可辨識的制度地位。8月7日開議的Majlis使宗教領袖、官僚與地方精英能以共同機構處理爭議，第一批法案亦成為1906年憲法改革的基礎。然而君主仍控制軍隊、任命高級官員並保留重要權力，國會因此從誕生起便需要軍方容忍，也使1908年的圍攻具有可行性。1908年王室派在戰術上占優，砲火與突擊迫使國會停會並暫停憲法；1909年大不里士反攻和英國的直接軍事壓力卻證明，完全壓制國會會引發中央與地方分裂。1911至1912年第二次圍攻再次證明集中砲兵可以摧毀建築和議會組織，卻不能單靠砲擊消除已經形成的憲政主張。從軍事制度看，這段衝突迫使卡扎爾朝廷正視哥薩克旅、地方軍、新式步兵和後膛砲之間的差距，也讓外國看見德黑蘭政府容易遭受海上或邊境施壓的弱點。正式成果是1906年憲法、第一屆國會及其後的改革立法；軍事結果則反覆循環：國會被封閉又被重開，王室控制軍隊卻未能在每次勝利後穩固維持政治控制。
impactEn: The military and political result of 1905 was the acquisition of a recognizable institutional position by the parliament. The opening of the Majlis on 7 August gave religious leaders, officials, and provincial elites a common institution through which disputes could be processed, and the first legislation became the foundation for constitutional reform in 1906. The Shah nevertheless retained the army, appointed senior officials, and preserved important powers. The parliament therefore required military tolerance from the moment of its creation, which made the siege of 1908 feasible. In 1908 the royalists gained the tactical advantage, and artillery fire and an infantry assault forced the assembly to suspend its work and the constitution to lapse. The counteroffensive in Tabriz in 1909 and direct British military pressure nevertheless demonstrated that suppressing the parliament completely encouraged a rupture between the center and the provinces. The second siege of 1911 and 1912 again showed that concentrated artillery could destroy a building and its parliamentary organization, but artillery alone could not erase constitutional ideas that had already taken root. Militarily, the conflict exposed the uneven capabilities of the Cossack Brigade, provincial forces, newer infantry, and breech-loading artillery, while also demonstrating the vulnerability of Tehran to pressure applied from the coast or the frontier. The formal results were the 1906 constitution, the first Majlis, and the reform legislation passed afterward. The military results followed a recurring cycle: parliament was closed and reopened, while the monarchy retained the army yet failed to convert every tactical victory into durable political control.
result: 若以1905年首階段計，結果不是任何一方在戰場上的徹底勝敗：政府拘捕並擊斃Shaykh Muhammad Ali Babi，一度拘押Hji Mohammad Kazim，卻未能迫使反對派解散；Kazim其後獲釋，國王於8月5日讓步，Majlis在8月7日正式開議。政府取得短期戰術成果，但以持久代表制度取代單純逮捕已成為不可逆的制度轉折。完整革命弧線則顯示，王室派在1908年和1912年的圍攻中都能摧毀國會的物理與組織基礎；1909年的地方反攻、外國壓力以及國會本身的持續存在，又迫使王權反覆恢復國會。1912年1月司法宮被砲火迫使投降，標誌第一次立憲議會時期的軍事結束，卻不是憲政要求從此消失。各階段均有零散傷亡，但可靠數字不存在，不能把傳聞中的死亡人數當作戰果。整體而言，這是一場以有限軍力包圍首都政治核心、以砲兵決定建築與議會能否運作的內戰；王室在若干戰術局面占優，立憲派則在1905年建立制度、於1906年取得正式憲法，並迫使君主反覆面對它。
resultEn: If the first phase of 1905 alone is measured, neither side achieved a complete battlefield victory. The government arrested and killed Shaykh Muhammad Ali Babi and briefly detained Hji Mohammad Kazim, but it did not compel the opposition to dissolve. Kazim was released, the Shah conceded on 5 August, and the Majlis formally opened on 7 August. The government gained short-term tactical results, yet the replacement of simple arrest procedures by a durable representative institution had become an irreversible institutional turning point. The complete revolutionary arc shows that the royalists could destroy the physical and organizational foundations of the parliament in both 1908 and 1912. The provincial counteroffensive of 1909, foreign pressure, and the continued existence of the Majlis repeatedly forced the monarchy to restore it. The capitulation of the Edifice of Justice under artillery fire in January 1912 marked the military end of the first constitutional parliamentary period, but constitutional claims did not thereby disappear. Scattered casualties occurred in every phase, yet no reliable total exists and rumored death counts cannot be treated as battle results. Overall, this was a civil war fought by limiting the capital's political center and using artillery to determine whether the parliament could continue to function. The monarchy held the advantage in several tactical situations, while the constitutional side established an institution in 1905, obtained a formal constitution in 1906, and repeatedly compelled the monarch to confront it.
